name: Remaining Drops of Purest Water
summary: Across Kalimdor and Lordaeron, shaman gather what Brine needs for a draught. Its last drops wait for a perilous journey.

sections.title: A Remedy for Defiled Waters
sections.body: Brine prepares a water draught in the Barrens from water gathered across Kalimdor and Lordaeron. Part of it gives shaman vision of distant elements. The remaining drops are kept for a harder purpose. Shaman carry them to the coast of Silverpine Forest, near the Sepulcher, where the Brazier of Everfount stands. There, the drops are burned with the bracers of a fallen, tainted elemental. The pure water cuts through the undead plague’s corruption, calling an untainted water spirit to commune with the shaman and complete their communion with the element.

faq.q: What are these drops used for?
faq.answer: The drops go onto the Brazier of Everfount on Silverpine Forest’s coast with the bracers of a corrupt water manifestation. The ritual cleanses the corrupted elemental shrine and summons an uncorrupted water spirit.

faq.q: Where did the liquid come from?
faq.answer: They are the leftover portion of a purifying draught prepared by Brine, an orc shaman who lives on a hill in the southern Barrens. He makes it during the spiritual trials of aspiring shaman.

faq.q: Why is the ritual performed all the way in Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: A water shrine on the Silverpine coast, west of the Sepulcher, was corrupted by the plague of undeath. Its elemental spirits became hostile and twisted. Cleansing that pool tests a shaman’s devotion and mastery across great distances.

faq.q: What happens when they touch the brazier?
faq.answer: Poured onto the brazier’s flames with the corrupted bracers, the drops crackle in the fire. The incantation cleanses the lingering plague and summons a pure water manifestation.

angles.text: As a shaman, you carry the drops from the arid Barrens to Silverpine’s blighted coast as part of your trials to master water. This pilgrimage is essential to earning your Water Totem.

As a member of the Horde, you travel from Horde territory in Kalimdor to the precarious Forsaken holdings in Silverpine. The pilgrimage carries spiritual restoration against the Scourge blight across that distance.
